text.p: Fastlane International Enterprises Inc said Friday it executed a major recapitalization plan, under which Robert Smith will invest $2,000,000 in common stock of the company.

Smith, president of Oak Brook Management Corp, is expected to be elected to the Fastlane board and will own 85 percent of the company's issued and outstanding common stock after the recapitalization is completed.
Also expected to be named to the board will be Edward Hayes, chief financial officer of Oak Brook Management.
Smith also will make additional financing available to the company, Fastlane said.

Agreements were also made with Mervyn Phillips Jr and Joseph Lickteig, directors of the company, who will convert $2,830,000 of existing bank and other short-term indebtedness of the company into common stock.
Further specific terms were not announced.
Fastlane said the agreements are subject to shareholder approval, and include a provision for a one-for-five reverse stock split.
An annual shareholders meeting has been set for January 14 to elect directors and approve the recapitalization plan and a reverse stock split.
Fastlane designs and markets hats and accessories for Nautica Enterprises Inc.
